organization.name: Walletbeat
organization.summary: Open-source (MIT) project that rates software and hardware Ethereum wallets on security, privacy, self-sovereignty, transparency and ecosystem attributes. Its about page says it was created and is hosted by Fluidkey, a Swiss company with a wallet offering, that Fluidkey wallets are not rated, and that it refuses funding from wallet-related entities. The goal stated there is to become an independent DAO or foundation.

claims.claim: Walletbeat is a live rating site at walletbeat.eth.limo with a public repository under the MIT license.
claims.method: Site returns HTTP 200. GitHub API shows MIT license, 137 stars, 106 forks, last push 2026-11-28 and about 3,411 commits on the default branch since 2025-11-28.

claims.claim: A public test page applies the benchmark transactions to any wallet.
claims.method: The page loads a wallet test playground with ERC20 approve, transfer, Aave supply, EIP-7702 batch and custom transaction tests, and an ERC-8213 tab. No wallet was connected, so results were not run.

claims.claim: An impact log file exists in the repository and lists dated wallet reactions.
claims.method: The file exists and lists dated wallet reactions from 2025-12 to 2026-09 with links to posts. The linked posts on X were not opened, so whether the wallets made the changes is not verified.

claims.claim: As of October 8, 2026, none of the 32 hardware and software wallets listed passes Walletbeat's transaction legibility test.
claims.method: Walletbeat's menu now lists 24 software and 11 hardware wallets, not 32, and the per-wallet ratings were not read. The statement is dated and was not re-tested.

claims.claim: Six software wallets are already tested for clear signing.
claims.method: Per-wallet clear signing ratings were not read, so the count of six was not confirmed.

claims.claim: At least 11 hardware and 16 software wallets will be rated on clear signing and at least 4 software and 3 hardware vendors will release fixes.
claims.method: These are future milestones. The proposal marks none as done and no completed retest was found.

claims.claim: Walletbeat accepts no payment from wallet teams and no team member is affiliated with a rated wallet.
claims.method: The about page states the funding policy and that Fluidkey wallets are not rated. The statement is Walletbeat's own and no independent check was possible.
